verdict.rationale: Automated triage is a fair axis for a project-management tool like Shortcut, but the evidence shows no first-party AI that triages or prioritizes incoming bugs and tasks. The documented Automations only cover non-AI rules for Epics and Iterations. The API and MCP server are developer building blocks, and 'agents work alongside your team' describes coding agents, not triage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have AI automatically triage and prioritize incoming bugs and tasks
